newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - Feb 25.

text.p: * News Corp Ltd announced an alliance with EchoStar Communications Corp to offer a subscription television service in the United States that would compete with cable providers.
News Corp said it was paying $1.3 billion in cash and other assets for 50 percent of EchoStar, which is based in Englewood, Calif.
News Corp closed at 21-1/4 in New York Monday. EchoStar closed at 18.

* Micron Technology was up 1/4 at 37-1/8 in London after rising 2-5/8 in New York Monday, lifted by comments from Merrill Lynch analyst Thomas Kurlak, who said the recent retreat in semiconductor stocks was due to portfolio selling.
* Motorola Inc was down 1/4 at 58-3/8 in London following press reports that the company was losing sales to rivals in the U.S. digital telephone business.

* Applied Materials Inc said it expected further gains in market share and saw sales growth continuing at a compound annual rate of 32 percent, fueled by accelerating demand for semiconductors. Shares closed at 50-1/4.
